description: Implementation of TCPClientSocket class managing TCP socket connections, including connection attempts, binding, configuration, and suspend handling within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: TCPClientSocket
classes.description: Manages TCP socket connection lifecycle, including connection attempts, configuration, suspend handling, and metrics reporting.

methods.name: CreateFromBoundSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCPClientSocket from an existing bound socket, with specified addresses and network quality estimator.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific local address.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keep-alive packets.

methods.name: SetNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables Nagle's algorithm (TCP_NODELAY).

methods.name: SetBeforeConnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be run before attempting to connect.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to the specified addresses, with callback on completion.

methods.name: ReadCommon
methods.description: Performs a read operation, either blocking or if-ready.

methods.name: DoConnectLoop
methods.description: Handles the connection attempt loop, managing multiple addresses.

methods.name: DoConnect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the current address.

methods.name: DoConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a connection attempt, including fallbacks.

methods.name: OnConnectAttemptTimeout
methods.description: Handles connection timeout event.

methods.name: ConnectInternal
methods.description: Starts the asynchronous connect process to a specific endpoint.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the socket and resets connection state.

methods.name: DoDisconnect
methods.description: Performs the actual socket closure and cleanup.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used for data transfer.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN negotiation was performed (always false here).

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol (unknown here).

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info (not supported here).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if socket is ready.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels a pending read if-ready operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor for testing.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles system suspend event, closing socket and marking suspended state.

methods.name: DidCompleteConnect
methods.description: Handles completion of connection attempt.

methods.name: DidCompleteRead
methods.description: Handles completion of read operation.

methods.name: DidCompleteWrite
methods.description: Handles completion of write operation.

methods.name: DidCompleteReadWrite
methods.description: Handles completion of read/write callback.

methods.name: OpenSocket
methods.description: Opens a socket with specified address family.

methods.name: EmitTCPMetricsHistogramsOnDisconnect
methods.description: Records TCP metrics at disconnect.

methods.name: EmitConnectAttemptHistograms
methods.description: Records histograms for connection attempts.

methods.name: GetConnectAttemptTimeout
methods.description: Calculates timeout for connection attempts based on network quality.
